note: The script asks for the hook text, one name super, one question text, two key words, one key line and the end card, so 5 graphics and the end card. The CASS logo file is not in endcards/ yet, so the end card types CASS until it is added.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: Your neighbors. Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:05 for 3 s, lower left above the captions: Brittnie Stanton / Chief Program Officer, CASS.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:05 for 3 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line Chief Program Officer, CASS under the name.

mg.title: Question text

text.main: Why is it so important that the teams here work together as one?

mg.cue: Question text at 00:11 for 3 s, top band: Why is it so important that the teams here work together as one?
mg.use: Put it on at 00:11 for 3 s in the top band, before her answer lands.

mg.title: Key words
mg.cue: Key words in the top band as she says them: Landing pad at 00:23, then Launching pad at 00:30.
mg.use: Start at 00:23 on <landing pad>. Trim or hold so <Launching pad> lands at 00:30 as she says it. Top band.

mg.title: Key line

text.main: The dignity we can restore to them is invaluable.

mg.cue: Key line in the top band, word by word as she says it: The dignity we can restore to them is invaluable.
mg.use: Start it as she says <The dignity> (about 00:45). Top band, captions stay on.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card: CASS logo, then the line For more information visit cassaz.org.
mg.src: No CASS end card or logo in endcards/ yet (checked 3 Nov 2026), so CASS is typed. Line from the script's end card row; colours from the CASS brand (navy #2C2B77, white).
mg.use: After her last line at 00:47. Hold it to the end. Swap in the CASS logo once it is in the repo.
